title: Prepositions of Place: Advanced
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Dominas ahora las preposiciones de lugar avanzadas, esenciales para describir entornos de oficina, ubicaciones y distribuciones de espacios.

parts.visual: Preposiciones básicas: In (dentro de), On (sobre), At (en un punto exacto). Avanzadas: Above (encima de), Below (debajo de), In front of (delante de), Behind (detrás de).
parts.audio: Basic prepositions: In meaning inside, On meaning on the surface, At for an exact point. Advanced: Above, Below, In front of, Behind.

parts.visual: Más preposiciones de lugar: Next to / Beside (junto a), Opposite (frente a), Between (entre dos), Among (entre varios), Near (cerca de), Far from (lejos de), Inside (dentro de), Outside (fuera de).
parts.audio: More prepositions: Next to or Beside, Opposite, Between two things, Among several things, Near, Far from, Inside, Outside.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la preposición de lugar correcta.

questions.question: The files are ____ the drawer. (Dentro del cajón).
questions.explanation: In the drawer = dentro del cajón.

questions.question: The laptop is ____ the desk. (Sobre el escritorio).
questions.explanation: On the desk = sobre el escritorio.

questions.question: I am waiting ____ reception. (En el punto exacto).
The projector is ____ the table. (Sobre la mesa, superficie).
The clock is ____ the whiteboard. (Encima de).
The cables are ____ the desk. (Debajo del escritorio).
She sits ____ me in the office. (Delante de mí).
The manager's office is ____ the meeting room. (Detrás de).
My desk is ____ John and Sarah. (Entre dos personas).
She is popular ____ the team. (Entre varios).
The printer is ____ my desk. (Junto a).
The HR office is ____ the IT department. (Frente a).
questions.explanation: Opposite = frente a / al otro lado.

questions.question: The cafeteria is ____ the main building. (Cerca de).
The parking lot is ____ the office. (Lejos de).
The meeting is held ____. (Fuera del edificio).
Everything is stored ____ the cabinet. (Dentro de).
The agenda is ____ the table. (Encima de - en la superficie).
Sit ____ me so you can see the screen. (Junto a mí).
questions.explanation: Beside = junto a (sinónimo de next to).

questions.question: The whiteboard is ____ the wall. (En la pared).
questions.explanation: On the wall = en la pared (sobre la superficie).

questions.question: He sits ____ the window. (Junto a la ventana).
questions.explanation: By the window = junto a la ventana.
